cells: Regional Dex — Complete BST & Ability Balance Pass v2
COMPLETE — all 187 current dex identities balanced
187-Monster Ability & BST Design Handoff from the design chat

Every species uses the design handoff's relative stat shape (VH / H / M-H / M / M-L / L / VL) as the governing distribution, then allocates the exact target BST across HP, Attack, Defense, Sp. Atk, Sp. Def and Speed. This keeps intentional strengths and weaknesses intact. BST is formula-calculated on the Full Dex sheet and the audit delta must remain 0.

The roster uses 87 abilities across 187 monsters. Most are reusable, simple Gen-III-readable effects. Signature abilities are reserved for defining starter lines, rare identities, fossils, pseudos, Watchers, box legends and mythics. Hidden abilities are more specialised but do not automatically erase a monster's intended weaknesses.
